topic: 专项练习 - 形容词与副词的比较级与最高级深度辨析

questions.question: Mount Everest is ______ mountain in the world.
questions.explanation: 在有明确范围（in the world）的最高级中，形容词最高级前通常要加定冠词 the。high 的最高级形式为 highest。

questions.question: This puzzle is ______ than the one we solved yesterday.
questions.explanation: easy 以辅音字母+y结尾，比较级变 y 为 i 再加 er，即 easier；修饰比较级可用 much、far、even 等，不能用 very。

questions.question: Leo didn't run as ______ as his elder brother during the race.
questions.explanation: 在“as...as”或“not as/so...as”同级比较句型中，中间必须使用形容词或副词的原级。

questions.question: Of the two storybooks, Lucy chose the ______ one to read first.
questions.explanation: 在两者之间的比较中，若特指“两者中较……的一个”，通常使用“the + 比较级”，故选 shorter。

questions.question: The weather today is even ______ than it was yesterday.
questions.explanation: bad 的比较级是不规则变化 worse；even 用于修饰比较级表示“甚至更加”。

questions.question: Singapore is one of ______ countries in Southeast Asia.
questions.explanation: “one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词”是固定句型，意为“最……的之一”。modern 的最高级为 most modern。

questions.question: The blue whale is ______ animal that has ever lived on Earth.
questions.explanation: 表示在地球所有生物范围内的“最庞大”，需用最高级并加 the。large 以 e 结尾，直接加 st。

questions.question: This math question is ______ more difficult than the last one.
questions.explanation: a little（一点点）可以修饰形容词比较级 more difficult。very、quite 和 too 通常只能修饰形容词原级。

questions.question: Who jumped ______ of all the competitors in the sports meet?
questions.explanation: 根据介词短语“of all the competitors”（在所有参赛选手中），可知是在三者及以上范围比较，应用最高级 the highest。

questions.question: The ______ you practice speaking English, the ______ you will become.
questions.explanation: “the + 比较级..., the + 比较级...”为固定句型，表示“越……就越……”。

questions.question: My new schoolbag is ______ lighter than my old one.
questions.explanation: far 放在比较级 lighter 之前表示程度深，意为“……得多”。more 不能修饰单音节加了 -er 的比较级。

questions.question: Winter is coming, and days are getting ______ and ______.
questions.explanation: “比较级 + and + 比较级”表示“越来越……”。short 的比较级为 shorter。

questions.question: Emma sings ______ than her classmate Sarah.
questions.explanation: 此处修饰动词 sings 需用副词，且句中有 than 表比较，多音节副词 beautifully 的比较级为 more beautifully。

questions.question: Which lake is deeper, Lake Superior ______ Lake Baikal?
questions.explanation: 选择疑问句中，并列提供两个选项时应用连词 or 连接。

questions.question: My grandfather walked a little ______ today because his knee hurt.
questions.explanation: 句子隐含今日与平时的比较，且被 a little 修饰，多音节副词 slowly 的比较级为 more slowly。

questions.question: Peter is the tallest boy ______ our class.
questions.explanation: 最高级表示在某个空间、范围或集体内部（如 class, school, city）时，介词习惯用 in；表示在同一类同伴或数量中时多用 of。

questions.question: Among all the subjects, Mia thinks science is ______.
questions.explanation: 由介词短语 Among all the subjects（在所有学科中）可知需用最高级 the most interesting。

questions.question: Our house is twice as ______ as theirs.
questions.explanation: 倍数表达法“倍数 + as + 形容词原级 + as”中，必须用形容词原形 large。

questions.question: He has ______ books than his sister, but he reads them more often.
questions.explanation: books 为可数名词复数，表示“更少”需用 few 的比较级 fewer。less 修饰不可数名词。

questions.question: Drink ______ soda and ______ water if you want to stay healthy.
questions.explanation: soda（苏打汽水）和 water（水）均为不可数名词。修饰不可数名词表示“更少”用 less，“更多”用 more。

questions.question: The library is ______ away from our house than the supermarket.
questions.explanation: 句中有 than 表示两者距离的比较，表示实际具体空间距离更远时，优先使用 farther（或 further）。

questions.question: Jack is taller than ______ in his basketball team.
questions.explanation: Jack 也是篮球队的一员，若用 any boy 会包含自己（自己不能比自己高）。必须用 any other boy（其他任何一个男孩）将自己排除在外。

questions.question: This is ______ movie I have ever seen. I fell asleep halfway through!
questions.explanation: “This is + the + 最高级 + 名词 + I have ever seen”是典型句型，表示“这是我曾看过的最……的电影”。

questions.question: The population of Shanghai is larger than ______ of Tianjin.
questions.explanation: 比较对象需保持一致。此处比较的是人口（population，不可数），为避免重复，单数/不可数名词用 that 代替；复数名词用 those 代替。

questions.question: Can you speak a little ______? The baby is sleeping in the next room.
questions.explanation: 此处隐含与当前说话音量的对比，意为“能否讲得更小声一点”，由 a little 修饰比较级 more quietly。

questions.question: Henry works ______ than anyone else in our study group.
questions.explanation: 副词 hard 的比较级为 harder。句中有 than 明确表示两者或一方与他人的比较。

questions.question: Which season do you like ______, spring or autumn?
questions.explanation: 在两者之间选择更喜欢的对象（spring or autumn），应用 like 的比较级形式 better。

questions.question: This coat is ______ expensive of the three.
questions.explanation: 范围是 of the three（三件之中），表示“最不昂贵的 / 最便宜的”，应用劣等最高级 the least expensive。

questions.question: The air in the countryside is ______ than that in the crowded city center.
questions.explanation: fresh 的比较级是 fresher；前面可以用 much 加强语气表示“清新得多”。

questions.question: None of the tests was easy, but this one was definitely ______.
questions.explanation: 前句提到了所有测试（None of the tests），属于多者范围比较，因此指代“其中最难的一套”时应用最高级 the most difficult。
